description: This Java class 'JobStatsProcessor' handles processing of job statistics messages from a queue, updating job stats, and invoking a job service to process these stats. It manages message consumption, threading, and lifecycle events.

classes.name: JobStatsProcessor
classes.description: Main class responsible for consuming job statistics messages, processing them, and updating job stats via JobService.

methods.name: JobStatsProcessor
methods.description: Constructor initializing message consumer and thread pool.

methods.name: afterStartUp
methods.description: Method to subscribe and launch the message consumer after startup.

methods.name: processStats
methods.description: Processes a batch of incoming job stats messages, updates job stats, and invokes the job service.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources by stopping consumer and shutting down executor.
